project1.title: 2026 Intl. Youth Basketball Tournament · Full-cycle Campaign
project1.desc:
Full-cycle promotion for the 2026 LEAPBOUND STAR CUP International Youth Basketball Tournament, covering the complete communication cycle from pre-event hype to wrap-up.

Key work includes:
1) Full-cycle event marketing: scheduled articles, posters and videos to keep the event visible, and coordinated with NBA celebration promotion;
2) Social growth: ran the WeChat Official Account, Channels and Instagram, adjusting content strategy to event hot topics — Video Channel views surpassed 100K and a single Instagram post reached 1M+ views, breaking out of the core circle;
3) Content production: independently produced articles, posters and short videos, and conducted player & coach interviews, closing the loop from topic planning to design and editing.

project2.title: NJUDragon Boat Training Check-in Mini Program
project2.desc:
A dedicated in-team fitness check-in mini program for the Nanjing University Dragon Boat Team, sharing one backend and database with the web version with real-time data sync.

Core features:
1) Login: enter the team invite code + pick your name on first launch; the account is remembered afterwards;
2) Check-in: running (km) / swimming (km + stroke) / strength (body parts incl. core) / cardio (badminton, tennis, basketball, cycling, hiking, football, table tennis, dancing, custom); running/strength/swimming 2 pts, cardio 1 pt;
3) Leaderboards: five boards — overall / running / strength / swimming / cardio; 7 consecutive check-in days turn your name gold with a crown avatar;
4) Interaction: real-time danmaku, comments & replies on every check-in, with message alerts for mentions and replies;
5) Personal profile: nickname, bio, personal stats summary, full check-in history with edit/delete (own records only);
6) Admins (Yi Wang, Hailong Wu, Yingying Zhou, Alang Pei) can add/remove members; one-tap dark mode.

project3.title: Heilan Home Sportsday IMC Campaign
project3.desc:
Graduate course "Integrated Marketing" project: a complete IMC plan from strategy to execution themed around Heilan Home Sportsday.

Plan highlights:
1) Built a matrix of vertical community seeding (Keep/Xiaohongshu) + private-domain retention, connecting public exposure to private-domain conversion;
2) Quantified impressions, engagement rate and ROI with a metrics dashboard and dynamic budget allocation;
3) Designed content themes, KOL mix and campaign rhythm around the target audience's active lifestyle.

project4.title: Honor of Kings Middle East IMC Plan
project4.desc:
Graduate course "Digital Marketing" project: a full IMC plan for Honor of Kings' entry into the Middle East market.

Plan highlights:
1) Led market insight and competitor teardown, analyzing user structure, payment habits and local cultural context in the Middle East;
2) Delivered target user personas and a differentiated communication theme;
3) Designed a differentiated media strategy across digital advertising, content marketing, localization activities and offline scenes, with a rollout roadmap.
